what_happened: A docs job to resume the firstmate study with milestone M2 (long-running sessions) was rejected at final verification. One of 5 acceptance criteria was unmet: the criterion that `cargo test` and `cargo clippy` both pass from the repo root. The verifier raised one major finding. `cargo test` fails in the xtask spec tests (the_real_spec_covers_every_heading_and_addendum_of_the_brief and 5 related tests, 6 failed and 24 passed). The verifier judged these were almost certainly already failing before this change. The failed check is the test run (shard 4 of 6, `xtask --test spec`). It is a separate item from the unmet criterion. The study work itself was not reported as wrong, and the job was a docs job that did not touch xtask.
cause: The criterion makes the whole-repo test suite a condition of a docs-only job, but nothing records a baseline of which tests already fail on main. A pre-existing or drifted failure in unrelated code (the spec coverage tests against the brief) therefore looks the same as a failure the job caused, and it blocks the job. Nothing before the final verdict separates inherited failures from new ones, and the producer cannot fix xtask within a docs scope.
prevention: Before dispatch, run the test suite on the unmodified base and record the failing tests as a baseline. At verification, judge only tests that fail now and passed in the baseline. Report a baseline failure as an environment or main-health problem, not as an unmet criterion of the job. If main is red, raise a separate fix job for it first and hold dependents. For docs-only jobs, word the criterion as "no new test failures against the baseline" instead of "all tests pass".
proposed_request: Add a baseline test check to Athena. Before a job's producer runs, run the repo test suite on the base commit and record which tests fail. When the verifier judges a job, compare the job's failing tests with that baseline. A test that fails in both is reported as a pre-existing failure and does not make a criterion unmet. A test that fails only after the job is a job failure. If the base is already red, record a main-health finding that names the failing tests, and do not reject an unrelated docs job for it. Acceptance: (1) a test with a base that has a known failing test and a docs-only job shows the job is not rejected for that test; (2) a test where the job breaks a passing test shows the job is rejected and names the test; (3) the baseline list is kept in the job records. Then re-queue the firstmate study milestone M2 (long-running sessions) as a separate request, and open a separate job to fix the xtask spec coverage tests (the_real_spec_covers_every_heading_and_addendum_of_the_brief and the 5 related tests in xtask/tests/spec.rs).
